title: Q-ROOT-area-decay: area-decay keeps recurring: Give the area an advocate loop with a cadence and a growth item per run; attention weights lift neglected areas in the executor queue.
body:
**Owner:** project-manager
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe area-decay
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `area-decay` recurred on 4 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: no loop owns the area's upkeep, so work stopped when the area's first burst ended
Guard: `grep:foundation/temporal.py::neglect`
Remedy: Give the area an advocate loop with a cadence and a growth item per run; attention weights lift neglected areas in the executor queue.
Symptoms seen:
- temporal:69713c50e8: area:docs decay: 4 commits in 3 days after 100 in the 10 days before (10.0 a day)
- inbox:business-and-docs-areas-decayed-after-th: business and docs areas decayed after their first burst
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe area-decay


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (4 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): guard passes; last occurrence 2026-11-21
